apps.localizedDescription: uProVid is a build-it-yourself YouTube mod. Bring your own decrypted YouTube base IPA (local file or link), pick the tweaks you want - YouMod and YTLite resolve from their official upstream releases, anything else by direct .deb link - set the app name, bundle ID and version, and the Tweak Factory injects the selection with Cyan and publishes the result back to this source as a provenance-tagged release with digests. Until the first uProVid factory build ships (tag tweak-build/uprovid/* in this repository), the listing serves ASJTube 1.2.1 on YouTube 21.37.4 - the same publisher's ready-to-sideload YouTube enhancer with the YouPip / YouQuality / dislikes/privacy tweak stack - as a stand-in. Build one: python3 scripts/tweak_factory.py build (docs/TWEAK-FACTORY.md). Requires iOS 17.0+. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
apps.versionDescription:
Stand-in until the first uProVid factory release ships: ASJTube 1.4 by asjrx on YouTube 21.39.4 (the publisher's own ready-to-sideload IPA), with YouPip, YTABConfig, YouQuality, YouChooseQuality, YouGetCaptions, YTHoldForSpeed, YTNativeShare, YTweaks, VolumeBoostYT, Return YouTube Dislikes, DontEatMyContent, PleaseDontStopTheMusic and Gonerino. Once this repository publishes a tweak-build/uprovid/* release, this listing serves your own build instead.

Build yours: python3 scripts/tweak_factory.py build

compatibility.notes: Self-built lane: the base IPA is operator-supplied (a decrypted YouTube dump) and the tweaks are collected from their official upstreams by the Tweak Factory, then injected with Cyan. Factory builds publish under tag tweak-build/uprovid/* in this repository and take over automatically; until then the manualRelease stand-in below is served. Bases of YouTube 21.34.3+ require iOS 17.0+. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
